import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem isOpenMap_fst_restricted_bounded_union (X Y : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Set (X × Y)) (h : ∀ i x, x ∈ A i → ∃ U : Set (X × Y), x ∈ U ∧ IsOpen U ∧ U ⊆ A i) : IsOpenMap (fun p : (⋃ i : Fin n, A i) => p.1.1) := by
  have hA : ∀ i, IsOpen (A i) := by
    intro i
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨U, hxU, hU, hsub⟩ := h i x hx
    exact mem_nhds_iff.mpr ⟨U, hsub, hU, hxU⟩
  have hU : IsOpen (⋃ i : Fin n, A i) := isOpen_iUnion hA
  have h_val : IsOpenMap (Subtype.val : (⋃ i : Fin n, A i) → X × Y) := by
    intro V hV
    rw [isOpen_induced_iff] at hV
    obtain ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩ := hV
    rw [Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range, Subtype.range_val]
    exact hW.inter hU
  exact isOpenMap_fst.comp h_val
